signals.label: Lifetime definition
signals.finding: The vendor may discontinue the product, which ends a lifetime deal.

evidence.quote: LeadRocks reserves the right at any time to modify or discontinue, temporarily or permanently, the Website, Platform, and Extension (or any part thereof) with or without notice.

signals.label: Hidden caps
signals.finding: The deal says "unlimited", but the vendor's own pages meter usage. 3 reviews say limits were reduced.

evidence.quote: 1 credit is charged for all the contact details of one person.
my account only showing 50 monthly credits instead of what I expected based on my purchase.
I can't pull a fresh set of 10k leads in the vc & pe industry because the platform ran out of new contacts.

signals.label: Support complaints
signals.finding: 3 reviews (0.8% of all) say support is slow or gone.

evidence.quote: I also attempted to contact support using the email address that sent my login PIN, but my email was returned as invalid.
The "support team" will just drag you along telling you they are fixing it and will get back to you without actually doing anything about it.
Despite reaching out to customer service multiple times over several months, the responses have been inconsistent.

signals.label: Review trend
signals.finding: Newest 20 reviews average 2/5 vs 4.45/5 all-time (-2.45). 12% of all reviews are 1-2 stars.

signals.label: Tier trap
signals.finding: The $79 tier lacks 1 of 7 features in the $158 tier and includes a zero allowance.

signals.label: Vendor age & track record
signals.finding: Not checked: domain records were unavailable.

signals.label: Discount size
signals.finding: $79 vs a stated $1740 regular price (95% off).

signals.label: One-sided change clauses
signals.finding: The terms let the vendor change features or pricing at any time.

evidence.quote: LeadRocks reserves the right at any time to modify or discontinue, temporarily or permanently, the Website, Platform, and Extension (or any part thereof) with or without notice.
We may modify the Agreement from time to time. Any amended terms automatically take effect ten (10) days following being posted on the Website.

claims.text: LeadRocks provides a B2B contact database with 100M+ records including emails, phone numbers and LinkedIns

quote.text: LeadRocks is a reliable B2B contact database with 100M+ records, emails, phone numbers, and LinkedIns

claims.text: Users can search for and secure leads faster than ever

quote.text: Search for and secure leads faster than ever

claims.text: If the plan name changes the deal will be mapped to the new plan name with all updates

quote.text: If Plan name changes, deal will be mapped to the new Plan name with all accompanying updates

claims.text: Codes must be redeemed within 60 days of purchase

quote.text: You must redeem your code(s) within 60 days of purchase

claims.text: Previous AppSumo customers can buy more codes to increase feature limits

quote.text: Previous AppSumo customers who purchased LeadRocks can buy more codes to increase their feature limits

claims.text: Previous AppSumo customers will be grandfathered into the new feature limits

quote.text: Previous AppSumo customers will be grandfathered into the new feature limits

claims.text: Lead search supports filters such as job title, company name, location, industry and team size

quote.text: LeadRocks allows you to search for leads using filters such as job title, company name, location, industry, and team size.

claims.text: No direct CRM integration but data can be exported to CSV and imported into a CRM

quote.text: Currently, LeadRocks does not integrate directly with any CRM systems. However, you can export your data to a CSV file and import it into your CRM.

claims.text: LeadRocks collects only business-related data from official and legal sources ensuring GDPR compliance

quote.text: Yes, LeadRocks collects only business-related data from official and legal sources, ensuring compliance with GDPR requirements.

claims.text: Data enrichment adds emails and phone numbers using LinkedIn profile URLs

quote.text: Data enrichment in LeadRocks refers to the process of enhancing your existing database by adding additional information about your prospects, such as emails and phone numbers, using LinkedIn profile URLs.

claims.text: Email Verifier feature verifies emails in the dashboard to keep lists clean and valid

quote.text: Yes, LeadRocks provides an Email Verifier feature that allows you to verify emails directly within the dashboard, ensuring your email lists are clean and valid.

claims.text: Chrome extension extracts contact data including emails and phone numbers from LinkedIn pages

quote.text: The LeadRocks Chrome extension is designed to extract contact data from LinkedIn profiles or search results, allowing you to obtain emails and phone numbers directly from LinkedIn pages.

claims.text: Contact data is high-quality, continuously updated with worldwide coverage and high accuracy

quote.text: LeadRocks provides high-quality, continuously updated contact data, ensuring a decent worldwide coverage and high-caliber data accuracy.

claims.text: Email outreach automation allows personalized campaigns with scheduled follow-ups

quote.text: Yes, LeadRocks offers email outreach automation features that allow you to create personalized email campaigns with scheduled follow-ups.

finePrint.summary: The regular Starter rate is $29 for 1,000 credits, setting the baseline value for a lifetime deal.

quote.text: 1 opening = 1 credit, you pay $29 for 1000 credits.

finePrint.summary: Each revealed contact costs one credit, so lifetime-deal usage is metered by credits.

quote.text: 1 credit is charged for all the contact details of one person.

finePrint.summary: Support is promised only as best-effort help with no SLA or guaranteed response.

quote.text: You can fully rely on our support team. We will do our best to assist you.

finePrint.summary: The vendor can change the agreement unilaterally with changes taking effect 10 days after posting.

quote.text: We may modify the Agreement from time to time. Any amended terms automatically take effect ten (10) days following being posted on the Website.

finePrint.summary: The vendor can modify or discontinue the service at any time without notice and without liability.

quote.text: LeadRocks reserves the right at any time to modify or discontinue, temporarily or permanently, the Website, Platform, and Extension (or any part thereof) with or without notice.

finePrint.summary: Buyers get no refund even if they cancel early, indicating a strict no-refunds policy.

quote.text: The Client may early terminate the Subscription Term until it expires but neither License Fees, nor other payments are refundable.

finePrint.summary: The vendor can suspend or terminate access and delete the account for breach or perceived competition or disparagement.

quote.text: LeadRocks may suspend or terminate the Client’s access to or use of the Platform and Extension and terminate the Client’s account for the Client’s breach of this Agreement

finePrint.summary: The platform is provided as-is with no guarantee of uninterrupted or error-free access.

quote.text: We provide you with access to the Website, Platform, and Extension in accordance with the principles “as is” and “as available”.

trials.claim: Previous AppSumo customers can buy more codes to increase feature limits
trials.claimQuote: Previous AppSumo customers who purchased LeadRocks can buy more codes to increase their feature limits
trials.reasoning: A buyer with two licenses reported receiving only 50 monthly credits instead of the expected increased amount, directly conflicting with stacking codes to raise limits.

exhibits.quote: my account only showing 50 monthly credits instead of what I expected based on my purchase.
exhibits.argument: Buyer with two licenses did not receive expected increased credits, undermining stacking to increase limits.

exhibits.quote: You can add more credits by purchasing extra AppSumo codes on our deal page.
exhibits.argument: The vendor page states buyers can add credits by purchasing extra AppSumo codes.

trials.claim: LeadRocks provides a B2B contact database with 100M+ records including emails, phone numbers and LinkedIns
trials.claimQuote: LeadRocks is a reliable B2B contact database with 100M+ records, emails, phone numbers, and LinkedIns
trials.reasoning: Buyers report most leads lack phone numbers or have wrong numbers and that there is not enough data, materially conflicting with a 100M+ database including phone numbers.

exhibits.quote: most of the leads have no phone number. In other the phone is wrong
exhibits.argument: Buyer reports phone numbers are mostly missing or wrong, contradicting 100M+ records with phones claim.

exhibits.quote: Hi, I like the interface. However, there is no enough data.
exhibits.argument: Buyer reports insufficient data, contradicting large 100M+ database claim.

exhibits.quote: Get email and phone number directly on profile pages. Or download your people search results to CSV and upload it to the Enrichment tab to get contact details in bulk.
exhibits.argument: The vendor page confirms the product provides email and phone numbers and contact details in bulk.

exhibits.quote: LeadRocks can help you discover leads and provides contact details like emails and phone numbers, which is valuable for outreach campaigns.
exhibits.argument: A buyer confirms LeadRocks discovers leads and provides emails and phone numbers.

trials.claim: Users can search for and secure leads faster than ever
trials.claimQuote: Search for and secure leads faster than ever
trials.reasoning: Buyers describe the software as very slow and limited and spending three days pulling and verifying leads, conflicting with securing leads faster than ever.

exhibits.quote: the database is old and the software functionality is very slow and limited.
exhibits.argument: Buyer reports software is very slow, contradicting faster than ever claim.

exhibits.quote: I have spent the last 3 days pulling, downloading, and verifying and I am incredibly disappointed
exhibits.argument: Buyer spent days manually pulling and verifying, contradicting faster lead securing claim.

exhibits.quote: LeadRocks saves a bunch of our time! It lets you grab together the profiles you found, in one file, 1000 at a time.
exhibits.argument: A user testimonial on the vendor site says LeadRocks saves time and grabs profiles in bulk.

exhibits.quote: It is fast to fetch results, generous with the data/searches.
exhibits.argument: A buyer confirms the tool is fast to fetch results and generous with data.

trials.claim: Lead search supports filters such as job title, company name, location, industry and team size
trials.claimQuote: LeadRocks allows you to search for leads using filters such as job title, company name, location, industry, and team size.
trials.reasoning: The vendor page and FAQ list job title, location, company name, industry, and team size filters; complaints about state granularity and industry breadth do not show those filters are absent.

exhibits.quote: When searching for businesses in the United States, there is no option to filter by state
exhibits.argument: Missing US state location filter undermines claimed location filtering support.

exhibits.quote: The industry filter is extremely limited, we cant search for Home Services nevermind verticals within...
exhibits.argument: Buyer reports industry filter is extremely limited, undermining claimed industry filter support.

exhibits.quote: Drill down by job title, location, company name, industry, team size to get to high-quality leads.
exhibits.argument: The vendor page lists the same five filters for drilling down to leads.

exhibits.quote: Company name, job title, location, industry and team size are available for now.
exhibits.argument: The vendor FAQ confirms those exact search filters are available.

trials.claim: Previous AppSumo customers will be grandfathered into the new feature limits
trials.claimQuote: Previous AppSumo customers will be grandfathered into the new feature limits
trials.reasoning: No exhibits were admitted for this claim, so there is no evidence either way about grandfathering previous customers.

trials.claim: LeadRocks collects only business-related data from official and legal sources ensuring GDPR compliance
trials.claimQuote: Yes, LeadRocks collects only business-related data from official and legal sources, ensuring compliance with GDPR requirements.
trials.reasoning: A buyer reports personal Yahoo/Gmail emails being included, directly conflicting with collecting only business-related, GDPR-compliant data.

exhibits.quote: Even worse they do include personal yahoo/gmail emails, which is inappropriate for a country subject to GDPR.
exhibits.argument: Including personal emails contradicts collecting only business-related GDPR-compliant data.

exhibits.quote: For any purpose prohibited by applicable data privacy and security laws, including the General Data Protection Regulation
exhibits.argument: Terms prohibit GDPR-violating uses, shifting compliance responsibility to user rather than ensuring compliance.

exhibits.quote: The data we provide originates from only official and legal sources.
exhibits.argument: The vendor page states its data comes only from official and legal sources.

exhibits.quote: We have the whole legal department monitoring possible changes in law and ensuring alignment with GDPR requirements.
exhibits.argument: The vendor page states it monitors law changes to ensure alignment with GDPR requirements.

themes.summary: Many buyers say the data is years old with high bounce rates and broken verification tools.

hits.quote: records seem to be at least four years old.
more than 60% of the emails were invalid and bounced!
The bounce rates have steadily gone up and the lead quality is steadlily going down.
At best, 5% of the information that you find on LeadRocks is reliable.
only 2 leads were valid and rest of them are just crap
10,000 scraped leads: less than 100 correct emails!
Sometimes bad emails are as high as 80%.
Lots of leads have data from 2019-2021..
we get reverts like "this data is so old delete it."
the Email Verifier yields every email as unknown status.
it extracts 3 or 4 profiles and then fails
while scrapping the data the extension crashed after 100 contacts.
Then I verified the remaining emails with Reoon and I had 389 leads left.

themes.summary: Several buyers say search filters and coverage do not match what was promised.

hits.quote: they do not allow you to search for leads unless you have the company website.
there is no option to filter by state, even though state/province filters are available for other countries.
The industry filter is extremely limited, we cant search for Home Services nevermind verticals within...
I was unable to triangulate it down to the states and cities.
95 out of 100 companies not found.
OUR DATABASE IS NOT ABLE TO FIND ANY OF THOSE LEADS EMAILS.
pricing page claims "unllimited users" on ALL plans.

themes.summary: Several buyers say support is unreachable, inconsistent, or stalls without fixing issues.

hits.quote: I also attempted to contact support using the email address that sent my login PIN, but my email was returned as invalid.
The "support team" will just drag you along telling you they are fixing it and will get back to you without actually doing anything about it.
Despite reaching out to customer service multiple times over several months, the responses have been inconsistent.

themes.summary: Several buyers say credits, exports, and available new contacts are more limited than expected.

hits.quote: my account only showing 50 monthly credits instead of what I expected based on my purchase.
I can't pull a fresh set of 10k leads in the vc & pe industry because the platform ran out of new contacts.
You only get to save 500 at a time and each list can only be 5,000 results.

themes.summary: A few buyers say support responded fast and helped resolve access problems.

hits.quote: i will appreciate their support team because whenever i asked something i got a very fast response
There is also live support.
The support reached out to me to find a solution to this problem I've had for several weeks and we were able to resolve everything.

themes.summary: A few buyers say the tool is fast and finds real, accurate leads.

hits.quote: The leads are accurate, easy to grab, and simple to organize within the app.
It is fast to fetch results, generous with the data/searches.
There are real leads here and a lot of them.
